name: device_values
description: The values a field of the records of the kind takes in scope, with counts: learn the codes before writing a condition.

name: found
description: The condition of the selection; ends the turn. The console computes the list.

name: ask_admin
description: Ask the admin one short question when the request does not name the unit, the field or the value. The admin's answer comes back as the result.

name: refuse
description: Cannot be done; ends the turn.

other_kind.description: true: the request is of another kind (a change, a rule, a question about the system, a list), not for this assistant
